raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation Non-simulated path has been fused, so simulated path is slower than non-simulated path now. Acceptance-length simulation currently fills and copies several device tensors separately. Fuse those operations while preserving the existing CPU acceptance-length sampling and random-number sequence. Before, After, ## Modifications Cover both fixed-token and real-draft-token simulation modes, strided tensors, and empty batches; retain the non-CUDA fallback. This PR is independently based on `main`. QSA KV preparation is tracked separately in #40972. ## Accuracy Tests Independent branch test rerun: **24 passed** on NVIDIA B200. Each PR was tested from its own `main`-based source snapshot. Combined implementation validation with official `sgl-eval` 0.1.0, temperature 1, top-p 1, maximum 131072 tokens, 8 repeats over 30 questions, concurrency 128, thinking enabled, no acceptance simulation: | Mode | Correct / total | Accuracy | Length truncations | Request errors | | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | | Normal decode | 229/240 | 95.42% | 9 | 0 | | NEXTN, 3 steps / top-k 1 / 4 draft tokens | 228/240 | 95.00% | 8 | 0 | Real MTP acceptance length was approximately 2.146, including the bonus token, estimated by weighting the complete rounded log intervals by request count. Audited all 8 prediction files per mode against native metrics, generation settings and token totals. These are integration results with the optimization series enabled, not an isolated accuracy A/B for this PR. ## Speed Tests and Profiling **Benchmark scope: the E2E results below were measured with the full optimization series combined. Reproducing that implementation requires all PRs listed below, including this PR. They are not standalone performance results for this PR.** ### Full optimization series used for integration measurements - [#40972](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40972): Fuse QSA KV preparation and sparse block expansion - [#41166](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41166): Fuse small CUDA graph input buffer copies - [#41167](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41167): Reduce repeated overlap batch snapshot work - [#41168](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41168): Skip speculative KV allocation transfers when no pages are needed - [#41169](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41169): Fuse simulated speculative acceptance tensor preparation **(this PR)** - [#41170](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41170): Fuse speculative relay payload stores and avoid single-request gathers - [#41171](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41171): Fuse hybrid speculative state commits across state pools - [#41172](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41172): Fuse exact greedy chain verification with argmax finalization - [#41173](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41173): Fuse QSA graph replay metadata across draft steps - [#41174](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41174): Fuse Mamba tracking index lookup and skip uniform-position transfers - [#41175](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41175): Fuse NEXTN verify and draft graph input preparation Each split PR is independently based on `main`; the list above describes the combined benchmark source, not a required merge order. The combined AIME26 results in Accuracy Tests also use this full series (with acceptance simulation disabled). ### Evidence specific to this change This change fuses tensor preparation only for simulated speculative acceptance. No isolated main-versus-PR E2E benchmark is available; it does not accelerate real acceptance when the simulator is disabled. The combined E2E table below must not be used to infer this PR's individual throughput gain. ### Full-series E2E performance (all PRs above combined) Hardware and workload: NVIDIA B200 x4 / TP4, `nvidia/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4`, 8192 input / 1024 output tokens, 5 requests at concurrency 1, plan stream disabled: | Mode | Median TPOT across 3 runs | Decode throughput derived from TPOT | Median fwd occupancy across 3 runs | | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | | Normal decode | 4.1270 ms | 242.30 token/s | 98.90% | | NEXTN, 3 steps / top-k 1 / 4 draft tokens | 1.6936 ms | 590.44 token/s | 97.79% | Forward occupancy was collected with SGLang's device timer. Per-run values were 98.90%, 98.91%, and 98.89% for normal decode, and 97.75%, 97.79%, and 97.80% for NEXTN. These are full-series integration measurements with plan stream disabled; the NEXTN runs use simulated acceptance length 3.3, as in the performance table. Every run completed 5 requests and generated 5120 output tokens. Decode throughput is 1000 / mean TPOT in milliseconds; the table reports the median of three runs. NEXTN performance uses simulated acceptance length 3.3. These measurements do not establish an isolated main-versus-this-PR speedup. ## Checklist - [x] Pre-commit formatting and checks pass. - [x] Focused regression tests included. - [x] Independent branch test rerun complete. - [x] Current combined accuracy validation complete. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :x: [Run #39202046231](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39202046231) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #39202046213](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39202046213) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #39202046148](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39202046148)

@@ -39,6 +39,15 @@
     )
 del _mod, _fn
 
+register_kernel(
+    KernelSpec(
+        op="speculative.simulated_accept",
+        backend=KernelBackend.TRITON,
+        target="sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.simulated_accept:simulated_accept",
+        capabilities=frozenset({CapabilityRequirement.CUDA}),
+    )
+)
+
 register_kernel(
     KernelSpec(
         op="speculative.div_argmax",

@@ -0,0 +1,119 @@
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@triton.jit(
+    do_not_specialize=[
+        "BS",
+        "NUM_ACCEPT_TOKENS",
+        "PREDICT_SIZE",
+        "NUM_CORRECT_DRAFTS_SIZE",
+        "INDEX_ROW",
+        "PREDICT_STRIDE",
+        "NUM_CORRECT_DRAFTS_STRIDE",
+        "CANDIDATE_ROW",
+        "CANDIDATE_COL",
+        "TARGET_ROW",
+        "TARGET_COL",
+    ]
+)
+def _simulated_accept_kernel(
+    source_indices,
+    output_indices,
+    predict_tokens,
+    num_correct_drafts,
+    candidate_tokens,
+    target_tokens,
+    BS,
+    WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_ACCEPT_TOKENS,
+    PREDICT_SIZE,
+    NUM_CORRECT_DRAFTS_SIZE,
+    INDEX_ROW,
+    PREDICT_STRIDE,
+    NUM_CORRECT_DRAFTS_STRIDE,
+    CANDIDATE_ROW,
+    CANDIDATE_COL,
+    TARGET_ROW,
+    TARGET_COL,
+    REAL_TOKENS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    offset = (tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)).to(tl.int64)
+    row = offset // WIDTH
+    col = offset % WIDTH
+    valid = row < BS
+    base = tl.load(source_indices + row * INDEX_ROW, valid, other=0).to(tl.int64)
+    tl.store(
+        output_indices + offset,
+        tl.where(col < NUM_ACCEPT_TOKENS, base + col, -1),
+        valid,
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        num_correct_drafts + offset * NUM_CORRECT_DRAFTS_STRIDE,
+        NUM_ACCEPT_TOKENS - 1,
+        offset < NUM_CORRECT_DRAFTS_SIZE,
+    )
+    if REAL_TOKENS:
+        draft = tl.load(
+            candidate_tokens + row * CANDIDATE_ROW + (col + 1) * CANDIDATE_COL,
+            valid & (col + 1 < NUM_ACCEPT_TOKENS),
+            other=0,
+        )
+        bonus = tl.load(
+            target_tokens + row * TARGET_ROW + (NUM_ACCEPT_TOKENS - 1) * TARGET_COL,
+            valid & (col == NUM_ACCEPT_TOKENS - 1),
+            other=0,
+        )
+        tl.store(
+            predict_tokens + (base + col) * PREDICT_STRIDE,
+            tl.where(col == NUM_ACCEPT_TOKENS - 1, bonus, draft),
+            valid & (col < NUM_ACCEPT_TOKENS),
+        )
+    else:
+        tl.store(predict_tokens + offset * PREDICT_STRIDE, 100, offset < PREDICT_SIZE)
+
+
+def simulated_accept(
+    *,
+    accept_indices,
+    predict_tokens,
+    num_correct_drafts,
+    candidate_tokens,
+    target_tokens,
+    width,
+    num_accept_tokens,
+    real_tokens,
+):
+    assert predict_tokens.dim() == 1
+    assert num_correct_drafts.dim() == 1
+    bs = accept_indices.shape[0]
+    output_indices = torch.empty(
+        (bs, width), dtype=torch.int32, device=accept_indices.device
+    )
+    size = max(bs * width, predict_tokens.numel(), num_correct_drafts.numel())
+    if size:
+        _simulated_accept_kernel[(triton.cdiv(size, 128),)](
+            source_indices=accept_indices,
+            output_indices=output_indices,
+            predict_tokens=predict_tokens,
+            num_correct_drafts=num_correct_drafts,
+            candidate_tokens=candidate_tokens if real_tokens else predict_tokens,
+            target_tokens=target_tokens if real_tokens else predict_tokens,
+            BS=bs,
+            WIDTH=width,
+            NUM_ACCEPT_TOKENS=num_accept_tokens,
+            PREDICT_SIZE=predict_tokens.numel(),
+            NUM_CORRECT_DRAFTS_SIZE=num_correct_drafts.numel(),
+            INDEX_ROW=accept_indices.stride(0),
+            PREDICT_STRIDE=predict_tokens.stride(0),
+            NUM_CORRECT_DRAFTS_STRIDE=num_correct_drafts.stride(0),
+            CANDIDATE_ROW=candidate_tokens.stride(0) if real_tokens else 0,
+            CANDIDATE_COL=candidate_tokens.stride(1) if real_tokens else 0,
+            TARGET_ROW=target_tokens.stride(0) if real_tokens else 0,
+            TARGET_COL=target_tokens.stride(1) if real_tokens else 0,
+            REAL_TOKENS=real_tokens,
+            BLOCK=128,
+        )
+    return output_indices

@@ -89,6 +89,9 @@
     from sglang.srt.sampling.sampling_batch_info import SamplingBatchInfo
 
 
+if _is_cuda:
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.speculative.simulated_accept import simulated_accept
+
 if _is_cpu:
     from sgl_kernel import assign_extend_cache_locs_cpu
 
@@ -494,6 +497,18 @@ def generate_simulated_accept_index(
         simulate_acc_len, simulate_acc_method, spec_steps + 1
     )
 
+    if _is_cuda and accept_index.is_cuda:
+        return simulated_accept(
+            accept_indices=accept_index,
+            predict_tokens=predict,
+            num_correct_drafts=num_correct_drafts,
+            candidate_tokens=candidates,
+            target_tokens=target_predict,
+            width=spec_steps + 1,
+            num_accept_tokens=simulate_acc_len,
+            real_tokens=use_real_draft_tokens,
+        )
+
     accept_indx_first_col = accept_index[:, 0].view(-1, 1)
     sim_accept_index = torch.full(
         (bs, spec_steps + 1), -1, dtype=torch.int32, device=accept_index.device
